front.title: VXLAN and SRv6 Gateway Deployment Options and Considerations

abstract.t:
VXLAN is widely deployed in data center networks, often with Ethernet VPN (EVPN) as its control plane. Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6) is used to provide services and path control over IPv6 networks, including networks connecting data centers and wide area networks.
This document describes deployment options for connecting VXLAN-based data center networks to SRv6 networks. These options include VXLAN and SRv6 service interworking at a gateway, and the transport of VXLAN traffic over an SRv6 network. The document discusses their characteristics, deployment trade-offs, and operational considerations.
